questions.question: Binary search with mid = (first + last) // 2 is applied to [2, 3, 5, 7, 10, 11, 12, 17, 19, 23, 29, 31, 37, 41, 43] to find key 41. How many iterations are needed?
questions.explanation: mid = 7 (17 < 41), then first = 8, mid = 11 (31 < 41), then first = 12, mid = 13 holds 41. The key is found in 3 iterations.

questions.question: As per the syllabus, how many keywords are there in the latest Java versions?
questions.explanation: Latest Java versions have 67 keywords. 95 is the C++ keyword count, 32 is the C keyword count and 45 is the number of C++ operators.

questions.concept: Pages and frames for 13-bit logical and 12-bit physical address
questions.question: A system has a 13-bit logical address, a 12-bit physical address and a page size of 1 KB. How many pages and frames are there?
questions.explanation: Offset d = 10 bits for 1 KB. Page bits = 13 - 10 = 3, so 8 pages; frame bits = 12 - 10 = 2, so 4 frames.

questions.question: An antivirus flags a new program because its source code resembles patterns of known viruses, even though no exact byte sequence matches any stored signature. Which method did it use?
questions.explanation: Heuristics compares source code against known virus patterns; signature-based detection needs an exact consecutive byte sequence match.

questions.question: Which LPWAN technology, also called Cat-M2, stands for NarrowBand Internet of Things?
questions.explanation: NB-IoT (NarrowBand IoT) is also referred to as Cat-M2.

questions.concept: Round robin completion order with quantum 2
questions.question: P1, P2 and P3 arrive at time 0 in that order with CPU bursts of 5, 3 and 1 ms. With Round Robin and a time quantum of 2 ms, in what order do the processes complete?
questions.explanation: Timeline: P1 0-2, P2 2-4, P3 4-5 (done), P1 5-7, P2 7-8 (done), P1 8-9 (done). So P3 finishes at 5, P2 at 8 and P1 at 9.

questions.question: Which output device is used to build physical replicas of digital 3D designs, for example prototypes in manufacturing and medicine?
questions.explanation: 3D printers build physical replicas of digital 3D designs. A braille display helps visually challenged users read text output.

questions.concept: Tracing GROUP BY with HAVING on attendance
questions.question: ATTENDANCE has two days of records for roll numbers 1 to 6. Absences ('A'): roll 3 and 5 on day 1, roll 3 and 4 on day 2; all other entries are 'P'. Which roll numbers does this query return? SELECT RollNumber FROM ATTENDANCE WHERE AttendanceStatus = 'P' GROUP BY RollNumber HAVING COUNT(*) = 2;
questions.explanation: Only students present on both days have a count of 2 among 'P' rows: rolls 1, 2 and 6. Rolls 4 and 5 have a count of 1 and roll 3 has none.

questions.question: Which of the following is a common application area of Python?
questions.explanation: Python is used for websites, software, task automation, data analysis, visualization, AI, machine learning and game development.

questions.question: A robot learns to navigate a maze by receiving rewards for correct moves and penalties for collisions. Which type of machine learning is this?
questions.explanation: Reinforcement learning uses rewards and penalties; robot navigation and game AI are its typical applications.

questions.question: A freelancer designs a logo and sells it to a company through a crowdsourcing website. This is an example of:
questions.explanation: When an individual provides a product or service to a business (logo design, freelance work, crowdsourcing), it is Consumer-to-Business.

questions.question: Protecting the data within a class from unwanted access is called:
questions.explanation: Data hiding protects class data from unwanted access, while data abstraction means displaying only essential information.

questions.question: Which network type covers countries, uses routers and requires a firewall, with the Internet as its largest example?
questions.explanation: WAN is a telecommunication network spanning countries; the Internet is the largest WAN.

questions.question: In a Max Heap, the root node always contains:
questions.explanation: In a Max Heap the root is always the maximum element; in a Min Heap it is the minimum.

questions.question: Which of the following are listed as front-end web development languages or frameworks? Select all that apply.
questions.explanation: React and Angular (along with HTML, CSS, JavaScript and Swift) are front-end technologies; PHP and Golang are back-end languages.

questions.concept: Unbounded tape versus finite state set
questions.question: Which of the following in a Turing machine is unbounded rather than finite?
questions.explanation: A TM is a finite-state controller with an unbounded tape; the state set and tape symbol set are finite.

questions.concept: Composite primary key of ATTENDANCE table
questions.question: An ATTENDANCE table stores (AttendanceDate, RollNumber, AttendanceStatus), with one row per student per day. Which choice of primary key uniquely identifies every row?
questions.explanation: A roll number repeats every day and a date repeats for every student, so only the composite key (AttendanceDate, RollNumber) is unique; status values also repeat.

questions.concept: Inverter on SR inputs gives D flip-flop
questions.question: When an inverter is added to an S-R flip-flop so that its two inputs are always complements of each other, the result is a:
questions.explanation: Adding an inverter so S and R are always complementary removes the invalid state and yields a D flip-flop.

questions.question: Verifying the identity of a user is called ____, while granting access rights to that user is called ____.
questions.explanation: Authentication verifies identity and authorization grants access rights.

questions.question: As per the syllabus, which finite automaton allows backtracking?
questions.explanation: The syllabus lists 'allows backtracking' as a DFA characteristic and 'does not allow backtracking' for NFA.

questions.concept: Gateway as single entry and exit point
questions.question: Which statement about a gateway in an organisation's network is correct?

options.A: It can be implemented only as a hardware device
options.B: It is an eight-pin connector at the end of a network cable
options.C: It is an analog device that regenerates weak signals
options.D: All data entering or leaving the network passes through it

questions.explanation: A gateway is the key access point between the organisation's network and the Internet; it can be software, hardware or both.

questions.concept: Software engineering as application of engineering principles
questions.question: Software engineering is best described as:

options.A: The writing of code without planning
options.B: The repair of computer hardware components
options.C: The study of electrical circuits used in computers
options.D: The systematic application of engineering principles to software development

questions.explanation: Software engineering is the systematic application of engineering principles to the design, development, testing and maintenance of software.

questions.concept: NOW returns current date and time
questions.question: Which SQL scalar function returns the current system date and time?
questions.explanation: NOW() returns the current date and time; FORMAT() formats display, ROUND() rounds numbers and LAST() is an aggregate.
